researchSummary.finding: Forest Freeride is a real, verifiably active operator based in Llanbrynmair, Powys, mid Wales. It is run by Stuart Wright ('Stu') and his partner Dee. The operator runs the website forestfreeride.co.uk and is closely associated with Bear Bones Bikepacking (bearbonesbikepacking.co.uk), which shares the same physical address and operator names. Core services are bikepacking-specific coaching/courses for novice riders, guided trips, and the organisation of two well-known Wales bikepacking community events: the Bear Bones 200 (BB200) and the Welsh Ride Thing (WRT). The forestfreeride.co.uk homepage is currently returning a Shopify 'Coming Soon' page (admin.zz), but multiple internal pages and companion sites confirm the operator is active. Contact details, address, and phone are sourced from Bear Bones Bikepacking and require human confirmation that they apply to the Forest Freeride brand identity. No logo, cover image, Google Business profile, or tourism-directory listing was found.
